primary_reason: Residual income valuation adds no incremental information over book-to-price. X2 shows RIM V/P does rank constituent returns (mean IC +0.199 all origins, +0.292 window-complete, CIs excluding zero, positive in 31/34 and 18/18 origins) while plain B/P ranks them better at every origin set (+0.256 / +0.335), leaving the entire apparatus at -0.057 and -0.043 incremental. That result was reproduced exactly by an independent red team using its own statistics, and its two most dangerous attack surfaces - a construction advantage handed to the B/P control, and systematically different member drops between arms - were tested and cleared.
revision_note: This decision was first recorded with X3's Oracle failure as a co-equal reason. The independent audit (contract Step 7) showed that X3's verdict is not robust at n=13, so the X3 leg has been demoted to supporting evidence and the primary reason now rests on X2 alone. The decision itself did not change; its basis narrowed. Recorded rather than silently rewritten.
corrected_note: CORRECTED 2026-08-07 (DEC-291/292): the X2 IC figures in primary_reason and the first two evidence items were computed on a panel whose market caps mixed share bases (back-adjusted price x as-reported shares; up to 40x error, 274/848 cells affected) - see source/100xFenok/data/computed/feno-rim-recovery/RED_TEAM_SPLIT_BASIS_DEFECT.md and R0_ADJUDICATION_CORRECTED.json (independently reproduced by the red team). Corrected mean IC: V/P -0.0985 (all origins) / +0.1000 (window-complete); B/P -0.0292 / +0.1593; paired difference -0.0693 (ESS CI [-0.111, -0.027]). RIM V/P does NOT rank subsequent returns; the direction of this decision (retire the heuristic) survives on corrected evidence, and DEC-291/292 (2026-08-07) reopened and closed bounded validation of the canonical path with the ICC expected-return lens SUPPORTED (not validated) while this public-surface quarantine stays untouched. Recorded rather than silently rewritten.
evidence: X2 incremental criterion fails on both origin sets: V/P minus B/P is -0.057 (all 34) and -0.043 (window-complete 18). Independently reproduced to four decimals with the auditor's own rank, correlation and bootstrap code, no import of the handler's modules.

X2 attack surfaces cleared by the auditor: B/P is point-in-time on all three legs (book, price, shares from the origin panel), both ICs are computed on the identical member set in the same loop, so B/P's edge is real rather than a control artefact. Member drops are common to both arms and cannot manufacture the gap.

E1 terminated top-down B1: the model ranks below the same-origin historical P/B baseline on all four US indices, and the verdict survived X0's window-completeness recheck (full-window baselines 0.72-0.84 against the model's 0.15-0.64).

X0 established the current implementation is not the literature's RIM: consensus null at every origin, 6 of 7 components MATERIAL_DEVIATION against Frankel-Lee, the Dow bottom-up and Dechow. What was tested is a historical-accounting B1 heuristic per contract 8.1.
X0 voided E2's apparent pass: the '34/34 truncated' flag was a tautology, real truncation is 18 of 34, and on window-complete origins the baseline beats bottom-up (+0.447 vs +0.302).
X3 deployable arm fails on every origin set with CIs that never exclude zero (+0.033 window-complete, -0.549 all origins). This part of X3 stands.

X1 confirmed the period was hostile to value (HML -20.7%, Big Value minus Big Growth -44.4%) and found a positive factor-residual signal on the clean subset (+0.501, CI [0.331, 0.726]) - but its frozen interpretability bar fired INSUFFICIENT_MATCHED_UNIVERSE at R2 0.490 against 0.50, with effective n of 11.3.
known_weaknesses: X3's Oracle verdict is INDETERMINATE at n=13, not a failure. A non-circular moving-block bootstrap on the identical rows gives [0.041, 0.581] and would flip the matrix key to oracle_pass_deployable_fail; block sizes 1/4/6 return zero to the interval under both implementations. The handler reproduced this. The claim 'perfect foresight does not rescue the formula' is therefore NOT established and has been removed from the reasoning.

X3's Oracle is terminal-sensitive: rho is +0.231 with the committed 10-year linear decay, +0.474 at 5 years, -0.042 under a perpetuity and +0.394 with no terminal at all. The pre-declared terminal is load-bearing, so the Oracle measured the ceiling of a terminal specification rather than of residual income.

Whether an Oracle-quality V/P would beat B/P was never measured - X2 used the deployable value only. The contract forbids a fifth experiment, so this remains open and is disclosed rather than assumed either way.

The pre-result freezing of criteria cannot be verified from the repository: criteria and results entered in the same commits and the criteria files carry no generation timestamp. The auditor found no evidence of threshold fitting and the shas match the modules' fail-closed constants, but the timing rests on working-tree discipline that a later auditor cannot check. Future experiments must commit criteria in a separate, earlier commit.
rejected_alternatives: BUILD_VALIDATED_BOTTOM_UP_RIM - contract section 9A requires positive cross-sectional information AND incremental value over baseline AND a passing deployable arm. The first holds and is a real finding; the second and third do not.

REQUIRES_PAID_POINT_IN_TIME_FORECAST_DATA - the owner ruled out purchase. Note honestly that the audit weakened the independent argument against it: with X3 indeterminate, 'better forecasts would not help' is no longer demonstrated. The case now rests on X2 - the deployable V/P loses to B/P by a margin that forecast quality would have to overturn, and on the owner's ruling.
Adding a multiple-expansion term - forbidden by the owner and the contract; in RIM the market-to-book gap is already supposed to be explained by future residual income.
Re-running with a looser criterion - three frozen bars were missed by small margins (X1 R2 by 0.01, X3 Oracle CI by 0.030, X2 incremental by 0.043). None was moved.
next_action: Redesign the public valuation surface as an ensemble of independent lenses per contract section 9C - historical P/E and P/B percentiles, earnings yield against rates, Yardeni, ERP spread, long-run earnings normalisation, revisions and breadth - showing agreement and disagreement between methods rather than one unvalidated fair-value band. X2 supplies the starting point: book-to-price carries a mean IC of +0.26 to +0.34 on this basket, so the simplest lens is measurably the strongest one available. Move the RIM engine, the Yoo structure reproduction and the full audit trail to a research archive; preserve, do not delete. Backlog #380 - the point-in-time estimate archive - remains the highest-value follow-up.
